en.title: Pronouncing the Romanian Letter H
en.summary: Learn how to pronounce the letter h clearly in Romanian words like hotel.

sections.title: The sound
paragraphs: The letter h in Romanian always makes a clear sound. A letter is a written sign of the alphabet. This sound is a consonant. A consonant is a sound where the mouth blocks or narrows the air. It is a voiceless sound. A voiceless sound is a sound where the voice is off.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Open your mouth. Keep your tongue low in your mouth. Push air from deep in your throat. Do not use your voice. Touch your throat and you feel no shake. This sound matches the h in the English word 'house'. Now listen to (hotel) /hoˈtel/, which means hotel. You hear clear air at the start.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: You always pronounce the letter h when you see it alone. It is never a silent letter. A silent letter is a letter that you write but do not say. Hear the word (hotel) /hoˈtel/, which means hotel. You must read the first letter with air from your throat. Every h has its own sound.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not skip the letter h. Some languages never pronounce this letter. Do not stay silent here. If you say (hotel) /hoˈtel/ without the h, people hear a mistake. Always push air when you begin the word. Do not make the sound too harsh. Send soft air from your throat.
